chunks: 4987 - Al-‘Alā’ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said: “When the fornicator commits fornication, the spirit of faith departs from him; then if he seeks forgiveness, it returns to him.”

He said: “And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: ‘The fornicator does not commit fornication while he is a believer, the drinker does not drink while he is a believer, and the thief does not steal while he is a believer.’”
Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said: “My father عليه السلام used to say: ‘When the fornicator commits fornication, the spirit of faith separates from him.’”

I said: “Does any part of faith remain in him, or has it been entirely stripped from him?” He said: “No, rather some of it remains in him; then when he rises from it, the spirit of faith returns to him.”

key_terms.انْخَلَعَ مِنْهُ أَجْمَعُ: that it was entirely stripped away from him
key_terms.رُوحُ الْإِيمَانِ: the spirit or living reality of faith present in a believer
key_terms.فَارَقَهُ رُوحُ الْإِيمَانِ: the spirit of faith departed from him during the sin

ai.seo_question: Does faith leave a person when he commits a major sin?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that grave sins such as fornication, drinking, and theft are incompatible with the full active state of iman at the moment of committing them. It also emphasizes that through seeking forgiveness and ceasing the sin, the spirit of faith returns, showing the continuing possibility of tawbah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4987 - Al-Ala reported from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said that Abu Jafar (as) said:
"When a fornicator commits fornication, the spirit of faith departs from him. If he seeks forgiveness, it returns to him."
Imam (as) also said that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"A fornicator does not commit fornication while he is a believer, a drinker does not drink while he is a believer, and a thief does not steal while he is a believer."
Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) further said:
"My father (as) used to say: 'When a fornicator commits fornication, the spirit of faith leaves him.'"
I asked: "Does any part of faith remain in him, or does it completely leave him?"
Imam (as) replied: "No, rather a part of it remains. But when he ceases the act, the spirit of faith returns to him."
